proposals.action_title: Publish first 'Bold & Easy' Minimalist Coloring Book on Amazon KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'Bold & Easy' / 'Minimalist' coloring book trend for adults/toddlers is booming. It requires simple lines, bypassing his current API image generation resolution limit. He can compile 30 pages using Together AI (FLUX-schnell, free) or Pollinations via GitHub Actions and compile the PDF via a simple python script in Termux.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the existing 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline with a simple theme (e.g., 'Cute Cozy Hygge Objects') to generate 35 clean line-art images.

proposals.action_title: Upload 10 Parametric 3D Printing Files (OpenSCAD) to Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Functional 3D prints (gridfinity boxes, custom cable organizers, wall mounts) sell consistently on Cults3D for 1-3 EUR. Since he has 'produce_stl_parametric' and 'produce_stl_openscad' pipelines, he can generate highly customizable utility models that require zero artistic skills and 0 image budget.
proposals.first_action_today: Activate Cults3D profile and generate 5 variations of a parametric drawer organizer using his OpenSCAD pipeline.

proposals.action_title: Bulk Upload 50 Typography and Minimalist Quote Designs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Typography and simple quote designs do not require complex AI image generation, avoiding current API bottlenecks. Using the 'produce_quotes_minimal' or 'produce_literal_idioms' pipelines, he can output high-contrast SVG text designs that scale perfectly on t-shirts, mugs, and stickers.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 50 minimalist funny developer/entrepreneur quote SVGs using Termux/Python, then upload them in bulk using Redbubble templates.

proposals.action_title: Publish a Local-Interest 'Château/Patrimoine' Notebook on Amazon KDP France
proposals.why_this_works_now: Hyper-local niches have extremely low competition and high organic click-through rates. By using the 'produce_chateau_local' pipeline to create notebooks branded for specific French regions or historic towns (e.g., 'Mon carnet de randonnée - Châteaux de la Loire'), he captures intent-driven organic traffic.
proposals.first_action_today: Select 3 high-tourism French departments, generate 3 custom covers with local public domain map assets or simple text, and upload them as lined journals.

proposals.action_title: Launch a Godot 2D UI & Asset Pack on itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: The Godot Engine community is growing exponentially, and there is a high demand for simple, ready-to-use GUI elements, button packs, and icons. Hugo can use the 'produce_godot_assets' or 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' pipelines to bundle flat-style game assets and list them on itch.io as premium/pay-what-you-want.
proposals.first_action_today: Compile a pack of 100 minimalist flat-style UI buttons/icons using his SVG pipeline and set up the itch.io project page.

proposals.action_title: Launch SVG Vector Bundles as Pay-What-You-Want on Gumroad
proposals.why_this_works_now: Crafters, laser-cutter owners, and Cricut makers actively search for SVG bundles. Setting up a free Gumroad store to distribute SVG packs (from 'produce_svg_pack' or 'produce_literal_idioms_v2') with a 'Pay-What-You-Want' model generates direct email leads and tips with zero upfront platform cost.
proposals.first_action_today: Create a Gumroad account, package 20 retro-style SVG icons into a zip file, and publish it with a suggested price of 3 EUR (allowing 0 EUR free downloads to build an audience).
